deliverables.goal: Define the minimum canonical fields every active project dossier must carry before execution opens.
Make the law for importing external corpora explicit: what can become reference, plan, dossier, or queue work.
Standardize Build Now / Incubate / Park / Archive posture as a readable and machine-usable review layer.
Show how imported memory moves from corpus -> summary -> dossier -> plan -> execution eligibility.

execution_constraints: Do not reopen historical task memory as active queue work.
Do not let imported corpora become a second authority layer.
Do not collapse runtime queue and strategic ledger roles.
Do not allow project execution without a canonical dossier anchor.
mission: Tighten project admission, dossier quality, intake law, and portfolio classification before new imported-memory execution begins.
review_questions: What are the minimum fields a project dossier must contain before execution can start?
Which imported-memory states are reference-only versus execution-eligible?
How should Build Now / Incubate / Park / Archive interact with client delivery versus internal products?
What explicit rule prevents archive or prototype memory from bypassing the intake law?
